label: De ente root-interface controls: per accidens, non-causal ground, absent, self-ground, nonvacuity
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations of the shared vocabulary. (1) Per accidens regress, on Nat: n+1 causes the esse of n, all in act with distinct esse, and no link is per se; the #1629 other-cause step and the per se regress hold, while the per se bridge, the unrestricted regress premise and the regress conclusion fail. (2) Non-causal ground, on Bool at one world: true (esse equal to essence) causes the esse of false, and false grounds true without causing its esse; the first source, existing-in-act, the concreteness bridge and no self-causation hold, while the ground bridge and 'the first source is an actual root' fail. (3) Absent source: as (2) with no grounding and true absent from the world; the concreteness bridge and the conclusion fail, every other input holds. (4) Self-ground: true grounds itself and causes its own esse; no self-causation and the conclusion fail, every other input holds. (5) Nonvacuity: true causes the esse of false and grounds it, both exist and are concrete, and the link is per se; every input of the root-interface and per se arguments holds and so do their conclusions, including at most one root and the unique actual root. Statements about these interpretations only, not evidence that a per accidens series of causes of being, a non-causal ground of a first source or an absent first source is possible or plausible.
